rationale: The agent executed an order-changing write (modified the pending order and processed a refund) without first confirming the change with the user, violating the explicit policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. While it appears to have attempted to identify the user (find_user_id_by_name_zip) and acted on a pending order, there is no clear authentication beyond name/ZIP and no confirmation step prior to the modification. Additionally, it asserted a specific replacement item and refund outcome without presenting options or confirming that it is indeed the highest-resolution waterproof camera within the previous price as requested. These constitute policy failures, chiefly the unconfirmed write.
